definition: the AI compute bill against the category meant to hold it

settled:
AI compute is my main cost, at seventeen hundred and twenty a month against a category of a thousand.

The overrun is not the part that matters. What it means is that I am effectively not letting myself spend on anything else at all.

The category is not too tight in general. It is too tight for the places I can put it to work.

The compute does two jobs. It builds the systems that hold my safety level up from outside, and it builds the ones most likely to bring in income, starting as soon as within a few months to a year.

I now have a balance I draw down instead of a rate I spend per month, an investment mechanic, nearer a college fund: the hundred and thirty-five thousand allocated for my self-taught AI PhD, to last me until I am net positive on cash flow. The thousand a month stays in my discretionary alongside it.
